blocks.text: Turg'un iboralar: mantiq qayerda ishlaydi, qayerda yodlanadi

123-darsda **in / at / on** ning asosiy mantig'ini ko'rdik: hajm, nuqta, sirt. Kundalik nutqda esa ko'p joy iboralari tayyor holda ishlatiladi: **in bed**, **at home**, **on the train**, **in a car**, **on the left**, **at the top**, **in the picture**. Ularning eng oddiylari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 107-dars). Bu darsda ularning ortidagi mantiqni ochamiz va nozik farqlarni ko'ramiz: in bed / on the bed, in hospital / at the hospital, on a map / in a book, on the ground floor / in the basement. O'zbekchada bularning deyarli hammasi yana `-da` bilan aytiladi — shuning uchun xato ham aynan shu yerda ko'p.
in bed, at home, in hospital — artiklsiz: odatiy rol

Artiklsiz ibora joyning **odatiy vazifasini** bildiradi: **in bed** — uxlash yoki dam olish uchun yotibdi, **at home** — o'z uyida, **at work** — ishda (qayerda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar), **in hospital** — bemor sifatida davolanyapti, **in prison** — mahbus, **at school / at university** — o'quvchi yoki talaba. Artikl qo'shilsa, gap **bino yoki narsaning o'zi** haqida bo'ladi: **on the bed** — karavot ustida (masalan, kiyim bilan o'tiribdi), **in the house** — bino ichida, **at the hospital** — kasalxonaga tashrif buyurgan yoki u yerda ishlaydi. Yana bir juftlik: **at sea** — kemada, dengiz safarida; **in the sea** — suv ichida cho'milyapti. Artikl mantig'i haqida batafsil — 74-dars.

rows: to'shakda yotibdi / karavot ustida, o'sha karavotda

items.text: Shh! The children are already **in bed**, but they aren't asleep yet.
items.translation: Jim! Bolalar allaqachon **yotishdi**, lekin hali uxlashmagan.

items.text: Your shoes are **on the bed** — please put them on the floor.
items.translation: Poyabzallaring **karavot ustida** — iltimos, ularni polga qo'y.

items.text: My cousin is a nurse **at the hospital** where I was born.
items.translation: Amakivachcham men tug'ilgan **kasalxonada** hamshira bo'lib ishlaydi.

blocks.text: Amerikada **in the hospital** (artikl bilan) deyiladi; British English da bemor haqida — **in hospital**. Amerikacha **home** ham ko'pincha predlogsiz: Is anybody home? Bizning kitobda — **at home**.
Transport: on the train, in a car, on a bike

Qizil kitobdagi test (ichida tik turib yura olasizmi?) kengroq ishlaydi. Katta jamoat transporti — xuddi «pol» ustida yurgandek: **on** the bus, **on** the train, **on** the metro, **on** a coach, **on** a ferry, **on** a ship, **on** a plane, umumiy holda — **on board**. Faqat o'tiriladigan, odamni o'rab oladigan kichik transport — **in**: **in** a car, **in** a taxi, **in** a van, **in** a helicopter, **in** a small boat, **in** a canoe, **in** the lift. Ustiga minib o'tiriladigan — **on**: **on** a bike, **on** a motorbike, **on** a scooter, **on** a horse. Transport turi artiklsiz aytilsa — **by** car, **by** train (→ 128-dars); minish va tushish — get **on** / get **into** (→ 126-dars).

items.text: We met **on a ferry** from Dover to Calais.
There's no room for your guitar **in my car**, I'm afraid.
items.translation: Afsuski, **mening mashinamda** gitarang uchun joy yo'q.

items.text: Have you ever been **on a horse**? — Only once, at a wedding in the mountains.
items.translation: Hech **otga** minganmisiz? — Faqat bir marta, tog'dagi to'yda.

blocks.text: Tomonlar va qavatlar: on the left, on the ground floor

Tomon — chiziqning bir yoni, shuning uchun **on**: **on** the left / right, **on** your left, **on** the left-hand side. Harakatda esa predlog yo'q: **turn left**, yoki **to the left** (chap tomonga). Qavat — binoning «sathi»: **on** the ground floor, **on** the first floor, **on** the top floor. Britaniyada **ground floor** — bizning birinchi qavat, **first floor** — ikkinchi qavat (→ qizil kitob, 107-dars). Lekin yerto'la va chordoq — yopiq hajm: **in** the basement, **in** the attic; tom esa sirt: **on** the roof. **upstairs / downstairs** predlogsiz: The bathroom is **upstairs**.
Sahifadami yoki kitobdami? on a map, in an article

Matn va tasvirlarda mantiq shunday: ma'lumot **ko'rsatiladigan yassi sirt** — **on**: **on** a map, **on** the menu, **on** a list, **on** page 12, **on** the screen, **on** a website, **on** the internet, **on** social media. **Butun asar** — o'qiladigan yoki tomosha qilinadigan matn, surat, film — uning **ichida**: **in** a book, **in** a newspaper, **in** an article, **in** an email, **in** chapter 3, **in** a photo, **in** a painting, **in** a film, **in** the mirror. Shuning uchun bir gapda ikkalasi uchrashadi: **in** chapter 3, **on** page 47.

headers: in — butun matn yoki tasvir ichida

items.text: The new restaurant isn't **on the map** yet — it only opened last week.
items.translation: Yangi restoran hali **xaritada** yo'q — o'tgan haftada ochilgan.

items.text: There's a spelling mistake **in the second paragraph**, **on page three**.
You look just like your mother **in this picture**.

blocks.text: Chekka va o'rta: at the top, in the middle

Biror narsaning **chekka nuqtalari** — **at**: **at** the top, **at** the bottom, **at** the end, **at** the edge, **at** the side (of ...). Uning **markaziy qismi** esa hudud sifatida ko'riladi — **in**: **in** the middle, **in** the centre (of ...). Diqqat: **at** the top of the page (sahifaning eng yuqorisida), lekin **on** the page (sahifada umuman). Ibora: **in the middle of nowhere** — hech kim yo'q, chekka joyda.
Keng dunyo: on the coast, in the sky, in a queue

**on** chiziq bo'ylab joylashgan joylar bilan keladi: **on** the coast (qirg'oqda), **on** a river (London is **on** the Thames — daryo bo'yida), **on** the border, **on** the way, **on** the outskirts (chekkasida; lekin **in** the suburbs). Ferma — yer maydoni: **on** a farm. Keng makon va saflar esa **in**: **in** the sky, **in** the world, **in** the countryside, **in** the distance (uzoqda), **in** a queue, **in** a row, **in** a line. Diqqat: «dunyodagi eng ...» — the biggest **in** the world («of the world» emas).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «in home» → **at home**; «at the bed» → **in bed**; «on the taxi» → **in the taxi**; «in the bus» → **on the bus**; «in the left» → **on the left**; «in the ground floor» → **on the ground floor**; «on the basement» → **in the basement**; «in the map» → **on the map**; «on the photo» → **in the photo**; «in the top of the page» → **at the top**; «at the middle» → **in the middle**; «the tallest building of the world» → **in the world**.

Ikki tezkor test. 1) **Rolmi yoki binomi?** «U nima qilyapti?» (yotibdi, ishlayapti, davolanyapti) — artiklsiz: in bed, at work, in hospital; «Qaysi bino, qaysi narsa?» — artikl bilan. 2) **Ko'rsatkichmi yoki asarmi?** Ko'z yuguriladigan yassi joy (xarita, menyu, ekran, sahifa) — **on**; o'qiladigan yoki tomosha qilinadigan butun asar (kitob, maqola, surat, film) — **in**.

Bog'lanish: in / at / on ning asosiy mantig'i, burchak, old va orqa tomon — 123-dars; binolar va tadbirlar (at the station, at a party), shaharlar — 125-dars; get on the bus, get into a car — 126-dars; by car, by train — 128-dars; school / the school, hospital / the hospital — 74-dars.

examples.title: **in bed**, **at home**, **at work**: no article
examples.description: Artiklsiz iboralar joyning odatiy vazifasini bildiradi: in bed — yotibdi, at home — o'z uyida, at work — ishda. Artikl bilan — aniq narsa yoki bino: on the bed, in the house, in the office.

sentences.text: Nilufar is still **in bed** with a temperature, so she won't be at the lecture today.
sentences.translation: Nilufar isitmasi bilan hali ham **yotibdi**, shuning uchun bugun ma'ruzada bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: I'm working **at home** today because the office is being painted.
sentences.translation: Bugun **uyda** ishlayapman, chunki ofisni bo'yashyapti.

sentences.text: Don't sit **on the bed** in your dirty jeans — I've just changed the sheets!
sentences.translation: Kir jinsing bilan **karavot ustiga** o'tirma — hozirgina choyshabni almashtirdim!

sentences.text: Can you call me back later? I'm **at work** and can't really talk.
sentences.translation: Keyinroq qayta qo'ng'iroq qila olasanmi? **Ishdaman**, gaplasha olmayman.

sentences.text: It's freezing **in the house** — has somebody turned off the heating?
sentences.translation: **Uyning ichi** muzlab ketibdi — kimdir isitishni o'chirib qo'ydimi?

sentences.text: Most evenings Sarah reads **in bed** for half an hour before she falls asleep.
sentences.translation: Sara ko'p kechalari uxlashdan oldin yarim soat **to'shakda yotib** kitob o'qiydi.

sentences.text: Make yourself **at home** — there's tea in the kitchen and towels in the bathroom.
sentences.translation: O'zingizni **uyingizdagidek** his qiling — oshxonada choy, hammomda sochiq bor.

sentences.text: The dog has been sleeping **in our bed** again — look at all this hair!
sentences.translation: Kuchuk yana **bizning to'shagimizda** uxlabdi — bu yunglarni qara!

sentences.text: Aziz's father is retired, so he's **at home** most of the day.
sentences.translation: Azizning otasi nafaqada, shuning uchun kunning ko'p qismida **uyda** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Tom is **at work**, but he isn't **in the office** — he's visiting clients.
sentences.translation: Tom **ishda**, lekin **ofisda** emas — mijozlarnikiga borgan.

examples.title: **in hospital**, **at university**: role or building?
examples.description: Artiklsiz — u yerdagi odatiy rol: in hospital (bemor), in prison (mahbus), at university (talaba), at sea (dengiz safarida). Artikl bilan — bino: at the hospital, at the local prison, at the school.

sentences.text: Jasur's grandfather has been **in hospital** since Monday with a heart problem.
sentences.translation: Jasurning bobosi dushanbadan beri yurak xastaligi bilan **kasalxonada yotibdi**.

sentences.text: I was **at the hospital** all afternoon, visiting my aunt after her operation.
sentences.translation: Butun tushdan keyin **kasalxonada** edim — operatsiyadan keyin xolamni ko'rgani borgandim.

sentences.text: The man who robbed the jewellery shop will spend the next eight years **in prison**.
sentences.translation: Zargarlik do'konini o'margan odam keyingi sakkiz yilni **qamoqda** o'tkazadi.

sentences.text: Madina's husband works as a psychologist **at the local prison**.
sentences.translation: Madinaning eri **mahalliy qamoqxonada** psixolog bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: When I was **at university**, I shared a tiny flat with three other students.
sentences.translation: **Universitetda o'qib yurganimda** yana uchta talaba bilan kichkina kvartirada yashardim.

sentences.text: There's a big conference **at the university** next week, so the car park will be full.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta **universitetda** katta konferensiya bo'ladi, shuning uchun avtoturargoh to'lib ketadi.

sentences.text: Emma's son is still **at school**; he finishes in June and then wants to study medicine.
sentences.translation: Emmaning o'g'li hali **maktabda o'qiydi**; iyunda bitiradi va keyin tibbiyot o'qimoqchi.

sentences.text: Parents' evening is **at the school** on Thursday at six.
sentences.translation: Ota-onalar yig'ilishi payshanba kuni soat oltida **maktabda** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Bekzod's uncle was a sailor and spent months **at sea** without seeing his family.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning amakisi dengizchi bo'lgan va oilasini ko'rmay oylab **dengiz safarida** yurgan.

sentences.text: Have you ever been **in hospital**, or have you always been lucky?
sentences.translation: Hech **kasalxonada yotganmisiz** yoki doim omadingiz kelganmi?

examples.title: **on** the train, **in** a car, **on** a bike
examples.description: Katta jamoat transporti — on: on the metro, on the train, on a ferry, on board. Faqat o'tiriladigan kichik transport — in: in a car, in a taxi, in a small boat. Ustiga minadigan — on: on a motorbike, on a horse.

sentences.text: I usually read the news **on the metro** on my way to work.
sentences.translation: Ishga ketayotib odatda **metroda** yangiliklarni o'qiyman.

sentences.text: We spent nine hours **in the car** with two bored children — never again!
sentences.translation: Zerikkan ikki bola bilan **mashinada** to'qqiz soat o'tkazdik — boshqa hech qachon!

sentences.text: There were no free seats **on the train**, so Kate stood all the way to Oxford.
sentences.translation: **Poyezdda** bo'sh o'rin yo'q edi, shuning uchun Keyt Oksfordgacha tik turib bordi.

sentences.text: Several passengers felt sick **on the ferry** because the sea was rough.
sentences.translation: Dengiz to'lqinli bo'lgani uchun **paromda** bir nechta yo'lovchining ko'ngli aynidi.

sentences.text: Oliver left his umbrella **in the taxi** and only realised when it started raining.
sentences.translation: Oliver soyabonini **taksida** qoldirib ketdi va buni faqat yomg'ir yog'a boshlaganda payqadi.

sentences.text: Is it safe to ride **on a motorbike** without a helmet? — Of course not!
sentences.translation: **Mototsiklda** dubulg'asiz yurish xavfsizmi? — Albatta, yo'q!

sentences.text: Two fishermen were sitting **in a small boat** in the middle of the lake.
sentences.translation: Ko'lning o'rtasida **kichik qayiqda** ikki baliqchi o'tirardi.

sentences.text: Once everybody is **on board**, the plane will take off.
sentences.translation: Hamma **bortda** bo'lgach, samolyot havoga ko'tariladi.

sentences.text: In the mountains near Fergana, you can only reach the village **on a horse**.
sentences.translation: Farg'ona yaqinidagi tog'larda bu qishloqqa faqat **otda** yetib borish mumkin.

sentences.text: Why are you standing **on the bus**? There's an empty seat right behind the driver.
sentences.translation: Nega **avtobusda** tik turibsan? Haydovchining orqasida bo'sh o'rin bor-ku.

examples.title: **on the left**, **on the ground floor**, **in the attic**
examples.description: Tomon — on: on the left / right, on your right. Qavat — on: on the ground floor, on the top floor; lekin in the basement, in the attic, on the roof.

sentences.text: The lifts are **on your right**, just past the security desk.
sentences.translation: Liftlar **o'ng tomoningizda**, xavfsizlik stoykasidan o'tgan zahoti.

sentences.text: In Britain people drive **on the left**, which confuses many tourists.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada mashinalar yo'lning **chap tomonida** yuradi, bu ko'plab sayyohlarni chalg'itadi.

sentences.text: Our flat is **on the ground floor**, so we never need the lift.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramiz **birinchi qavatda**, shuning uchun liftga hech qachon ehtiyojimiz bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: We keep old furniture and the children's toys **in the attic**.
sentences.translation: Eski mebel va bolalarning o'yinchoqlarini **chordoqda** saqlaymiz.

sentences.text: The gym is **in the basement**, and the swimming pool is **on the roof**.
sentences.translation: Sport zali **yerto'lada**, basseyn esa **tomda** joylashgan.

sentences.text: Take the second turning **on the left** after the petrol station.
sentences.translation: Yoqilg'i quyish shoxobchasidan keyin **chap tomondagi** ikkinchi burilishga buriling.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's office is **on the top floor**, and the view from her window is amazing.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning ofisi **eng yuqori qavatda**, derazasidan ajoyib manzara ochiladi.

sentences.text: Who's the woman standing **on the left** of the bride in this wedding photo?
sentences.translation: Bu to'y suratida kelinning **chap tomonida** turgan ayol kim?

sentences.text: Please stand **on the right** on the escalators, so that people can walk past.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, eskalatorda **o'ng tomonda** turing, odamlar o'tib keta olsin.

sentences.text: James lives in a block of flats with twenty floors, and he's **on the nineteenth**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yigirma qavatli uyda yashaydi, u **o'n to'qqizinchi qavatda**.

examples.title: **on** a map or **in** a book? Pages, screens, pictures
examples.description: on — ma'lumot ko'rsatiladigan yassi sirt: on a map, on the menu, on a list, on a website, on the screen, on page 47. in — butun matn yoki tasvir ichida: in an article, in an email, in a chapter, in a photo, in the mirror.

sentences.text: Is Bukhara **on this map**, or do I need a bigger one?
sentences.translation: Buxoro **bu xaritada** bormi yoki kattarog'i kerakmi?

sentences.text: There's nothing vegetarian **on the menu** except salad and bread.
sentences.translation: **Menyuda** salat va nondan boshqa vegetarian taom yo'q.

sentences.text: I read **in an article** that coffee can help you live longer.
sentences.translation: **Bir maqolada** qahva umrni uzaytirishga yordam berishi mumkinligini o'qidim.

sentences.text: The exam dates are **on the university website**, under 'Students'.
sentences.translation: Imtihon sanalari **universitet saytida**, «Talabalar» bo'limida.

sentences.text: Is your name **on the guest list**? Otherwise I can't let you in.
sentences.translation: Ismingiz **mehmonlar ro'yxatida** bormi? Aks holda sizni ichkariga kiritolmayman.

sentences.text: The answer you're looking for is **in the second chapter**, **on page 47**.
sentences.translation: Siz qidirayotgan javob **ikkinchi bobda**, **47-sahifada**.

sentences.text: Kate looked at herself **in the mirror** and decided to change her dress.
sentences.translation: Keyt **oynada** o'ziga qaradi va ko'ylagini almashtirishga qaror qildi.

sentences.text: Everybody **in the photo** is smiling except my grandfather.
sentences.translation: **Suratdagi** hamma kulib turibdi, faqat bobom emas.

sentences.text: I can't read the text **on the screen** — could you make it bigger?
sentences.translation: **Ekrandagi** matnni o'qiy olmayapman — kattalashtira olasizmi?

sentences.text: As I said **in my last email**, the meeting has been moved to Thursday.
sentences.translation: **Oxirgi xatimda** aytganimdek, yig'ilish payshanbaga ko'chirildi.

examples.title: **at the top**, **at the end**, **in the middle**
examples.description: Chekka nuqtalar — at: at the top / bottom / end / edge / side of ... . Markaziy qism — in: in the middle / centre of ... ; in the middle of nowhere.

sentences.text: The terms and conditions are in tiny letters **at the bottom** of the contract.
sentences.translation: Shartnoma shartlari hujjatning **eng pastida** mayda harflar bilan yozilgan.

sentences.text: There's a small café **at the top** of the hill with a view of the whole valley.
sentences.translation: Tepalik **cho'qqisida** butun vodiy ko'rinib turadigan kichik kafe bor.

sentences.text: Our house is the white one **at the end of** the street, next to the park.
sentences.translation: Bizning uy ko'chaning **oxiridagi** oq uy, bog'ning yonida.

sentences.text: Why is there an old sofa **in the middle of** the road?
sentences.translation: Nega yo'lning **o'rtasida** eski divan turibdi?

sentences.text: The children built a sandcastle right **at the edge of** the water.
sentences.translation: Bolalar qumdan qasrni aynan suvning **chetida** qurishdi.

sentences.text: We had a puncture **in the middle of nowhere**, fifty kilometres from the nearest village.
sentences.translation: Eng yaqin qishloqdan ellik kilometr narida, **huvillagan joyda** g'ildiragimiz teshildi.

sentences.text: A tall man was waiting **at the side of** the road, holding a sign with my name.
sentences.translation: Yo'lning **chetida** qo'lida mening ismim yozilgan lavha ushlagan baland bo'yli odam kutib turardi.

sentences.text: Recruiters say you should put your strongest skills **at the top** of your CV.
sentences.translation: Kadrlar mutaxassislarining aytishicha, eng kuchli ko'nikmalaringizni rezyumening **eng yuqorisiga** yozishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Is the toilet **at the end of** the corridor? — Yes, the last door on the left.
sentences.translation: Hojatxona yo'lakning **oxiridami**? — Ha, chap tomondagi oxirgi eshik.

sentences.text: The fountain **in the centre of** the square was built in the 1970s.
sentences.translation: Maydonning **markazidagi** favvora 1970-yillarda qurilgan.

examples.title: **on the coast**, **on the way**, **in the sky**
examples.description: on — chiziq bo'ylab joylashgan joylar: on a river, on the coast, on the way, on the outskirts; on a farm. in — keng makon va saflar: in the sky, in the world, in the countryside, in the distance, in a queue.

sentences.text: Termez is **on the Amu Darya**, very close to the border with Afghanistan.
sentences.translation: Termiz **Amudaryo bo'yida**, Afg'oniston chegarasiga juda yaqin joylashgan.

sentences.text: Sarah grew up **on a farm** in Wales, so she isn't afraid of hard work.
sentences.translation: Sara Uelsdagi **fermada** o'sgan, shuning uchun og'ir mehnatdan qo'rqmaydi.

sentences.text: Can you buy some bread **on the way** home? We've run out.
sentences.translation: Uyga kelayotib **yo'lda** non olib kela olasanmi? Tugab qolibdi.

sentences.text: Brighton is a lively town **on the south coast** of England.
sentences.translation: Brayton — Angliyaning **janubiy qirg'og'idagi** jo'shqin shahar.

sentences.text: The new shopping centre is **on the outskirts** of Tashkent, so you'll need a car.
sentences.translation: Yangi savdo markazi Toshkentning **chekkasida**, shuning uchun sizga mashina kerak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: There wasn't a single cloud **in the sky**, and the mountains looked very close.
sentences.translation: **Osmonda** birorta ham bulut yo'q edi, tog'lar esa juda yaqin ko'rinardi.

sentences.text: We stood **in a queue** for an hour to see the exhibition, but it was worth it.
sentences.translation: Ko'rgazmani ko'rish uchun bir soat **navbatda** turdik, lekin bunga arzirdi.

sentences.text: Is Lake Baikal really the deepest lake **in the world**?
sentences.translation: Baykal ko'li rostdan ham **dunyodagi** eng chuqur ko'lmi?

sentences.text: After retiring, my parents bought a small house **in the countryside** near Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Nafaqaga chiqqach, ota-onam Samarqand yaqinidagi **qishloq joyda** kichik uy sotib olishdi.

sentences.text: From the hotel balcony, we could see the snowy peaks **in the distance**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona balkonidan **uzoqda** qorli cho'qqilarni ko'ra olardik.

examples.title: Mixed: beds, trains, maps and floors
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: artiklsiz iboralar, transport, tomonlar, sahifa va chekkalar — bir misolda.

sentences.text: By the time Dr Karimov got home, his children were already **in bed**.
sentences.translation: Doktor Karimov uyga qaytganda bolalari allaqachon **uxlashga yotgan** edi.

sentences.text: I left my laptop **on the train** and only noticed when I got to the office.
sentences.translation: Noutbukimni **poyezdda** qoldirib ketibman va buni faqat ofisga yetib kelganimda payqadim.

sentences.text: The emergency exits are **at the back** of the plane and **in the middle**, over the wings.
sentences.translation: Favqulodda chiqish eshiklari samolyotning **orqa qismida** va **o'rtasida**, qanotlar ustida.

sentences.text: Mum has been **in hospital** for a week, but the doctors say she can come home soon.
sentences.translation: Onam bir haftadan beri **kasalxonada yotibdi**, lekin shifokorlar yaqinda uyga qaytishi mumkinligini aytishyapti.

sentences.text: The phone number of the hotel is **at the top** of the booking confirmation.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaning telefon raqami bron tasdig'ining **yuqori qismida**.

sentences.text: We got lost because the village wasn't **on the map** we had downloaded.
sentences.translation: Qishloq biz yuklab olgan **xaritada** yo'qligi uchun adashib qoldik.

sentences.text: Jasur was sitting **in the back** of the taxi, checking his emails **on his phone**.
sentences.translation: Jasur taksining **orqa o'rindig'ida** o'tirib, **telefonida** xatlarini tekshirayotgan edi.

sentences.text: Is the chemist's **on the left** or **on the right** after the bridge?
sentences.translation: Ko'prikdan keyin dorixona **chap tomondami** yoki **o'ng tomondami**?

sentences.text: Lots of people **in the queue** were complaining because only one cashier was working.
sentences.translation: **Navbatdagi** ko'p odamlar faqat bitta kassir ishlayotgani uchun norozi bo'lishardi.

sentences.text: When Bekzod was **at university**, he lived in a hostel **on the outskirts** of Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **universitetda o'qib yurganida** Samarqandning **chekkasidagi** yotoqxonada yashagan.
